name: MyTVCalendar Sync
description: Automatically marks TV episodes as watched on MyTVCalendar.com when you watch them in Jellyfin.
overview: Syncs your Jellyfin watch history to MyTVCalendar.com

versions.changelog: Fix: the Sync Settings user filter compared GUIDs as strings in mismatched formats (hyphenated vs. hyphen-less), so a selected user never matched and all watched-status events were silently dropped. Now compares parsed GUIDs. Also restricted the plugin's API endpoints (Pair/Unlink/SyncWatched) to Jellyfin administrators.
